line_text: Balthier Let's have a look. Hm...the fuse is blown. That would explain why there's no power reaching the switch. If the wiring is any indication, I'd say this is a central power relay of some sort. As it stands, I doubt we'll find much still running down here.

trigger: requested by イベント常駐監督.錆びた突起物イベント1
speaker: Burrogh
line_text: I see you got the gate open. Oughta be able to look fer all manner of ways out, now. While the lights are on, the Passage ain't so bad. But let the charge drop, and some fierce beasts start comin' out in the dark. Openin' this gate probably took the charge down some. That gauge oughta show you how much charge is left. Hrm, 'bout thirty percent to operate somethin' the size of these gates, I'd say. Who knows how many more of these gates they got down here. You look fer these switchboards, you oughta be able to make yer way.

speaker: Burrogh
line_text: Don' get many visitors down here. Come scavengin' fer odds and ends, have you? I don't reckon you saw whatever caused that terrible racket just now, eh? Hrm. Come crashin' down straight on the stairs? That was the only way out! Guess it's time to start lookin' fer a back door outta this place. What about you? You plan on pokin' 'round these tunnels, best go prepared. I piece together what scraps of this, that, and the other I find into all manner of things. It may be I have somethin' you need. / Normally I get supplies I need off'n the caravans come through Nalbina. But Barheim Passage is known to have certain items not easily come by. I knew it weren't safe, but...well, here I am. / Don' get many visitors down here. You come scavengin' fer odds and ends, have you? Oh, the way out? It's just back up those stairs— To smithereens, you say!? Then there's nothin' left but to find some other way out through these tunnels. You'll need to get the power workin' again, 'fore that gate'll budge, though. The fuse in that contraption up the stairs is blown...but this oughta fix it up. / Made that tube fuse from parts I found down in these very tunnels. It's good as any you'll find, and better 'an most, mark my words. / You wanna make it outta here alive, best go prepared. It may be I have somethin' you'd want to, uh, purchase, eh? / What's that? No power in the Passage, eh? Can't say I'm surprised, tunnels as old as these. This gate ain't workin' none, either. Here we go...try putting this in that contraption up the stairs. / Looks like that fuse did the trick, but that don't change the fact it's dangerous down here. There's anything you want to be buying, be about it. / Find any good loot, you be sure and sell it here, you got me? Never know what I'll be able to cobble together fer you if'n you bring the right loot. / When it gets dark down here, some fell creatures come out of the woodwork. See a battery mimic, kill it afore it sucks down any energy. / Plan on explorin' the Passage, best go prepared. You lookin' to buy anything?

speaker: Vaan
line_text: Hey! Who turned out the lights? One of those!?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: I've heard of these: Mimics. / They disguise themselves as all manner of things, then strike when you're least wary. / Some of them have a fondness for energy, I'm told. / They gorge themselves on the stuff till there's naught left.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: So...what happens then?

speaker: Balthier; no name shown
line_text: Lights out. And it's worse in the dark. Much worse. / So, let them get too close to one of those conduits and they'll suck it dry. / (empty string)

speaker: Balthier
line_text: But don't worry. It'll give the energy back, if you ask nicely. / Sticking it with a sword helps too. Clock's ticking!

speaker: Fran; Balthier
line_text: The Mist seethes. / It reeks. Something's close.

speaker: Balthier; Vaan
line_text: Nice moves there, Captain. / You mean "traitor." / So they say. / But I didn't see him kill anyone. / My brother did.

speaker: Basch
line_text: Reks.

speaker: Basch
line_text: He said he had a brother two years younger. / I see. He meant you. / Your brother. What became—

speaker: Vaan; Basch
line_text: He's dead. / I'm sorry. / It was you who killed him!

speaker: Basch
line_text: I give you my word: that was not the way of it.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: A twin brother? Fancy that. / But still, the pieces fit. I'll give you that much. / And he did look like you.

speaker: Vaan; Basch
line_text: I don't believe you. / Of course not. / It was my fault that Reks was there. / I am sorry. / My brother, he trusted you. He trusted you, and he lost everything. / How can I believe you? / Not me then. / Believe in your brother. / He was a fine soldier. He fought to the last to protect his homeland. / No. Surely he fought to protect his brother.

speaker: Vaan
line_text: You don't know anything!

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Believe what you want to. Whatever it takes to make you happy.

speaker: Balthier
line_text: What's done is done.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Reks, sir. My name's Reks. / He's two years younger than I. Living in Rabanastre. / It's time, Basch! Save the discussion for later. / But if we arrive after he's signed the treaty—

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Sir! We have little time! You must go to the King! / It's as I feared. They're slowing us down.

speaker: no name shown
line_text: Captain, why? / Our king— What have you done? / His Majesty was a traitor.
